body.name: shrinking-overlap phase-transition handle
body.construction: \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{loc}}\) is the following derivation handle: scale the reset-sign perturbation in \(\mathrm{def{:}signed\text{-}depth\text{-}family}\) to obey \(d_e/d_b\le1+\delta_T\), derive its observed-path testing modulus as a joint function of \(Q\) and \(\delta_T\), and pair that modulus with a data-dependent selector between immediate weighting and the partial-history scores \(Z_t(k)\). The output object is the sharp risk function \(R_T(t_0,\zeta,1+\delta_T)\), not a preassigned rate formula.
